title: ID0399022-DC/Si-D/FI-[nqq1M7] -Unable to download FW version 5.0.23
description:
Reported behaviour/issue: FW stuck in Rollout
Root cause:
SWUPDATE bug
Workaround:
Update manually via Win SCP
On DAMEX Sanctioned List:
Siemens
Warranty Status:
Active
-----------------------------//------------------------------
Reported behaviour/issue:
After FW update the CFAST is corrupted
Root cause:
Unclear
Workaround:
Flash CFAST card with v5.0.23
On DAMEX Sanctioned List:
Siemens
Warranty Status:
Active
Note to Warranty Manager:
Complicated topic, we didn't request RC to replace the CFAST and caused delay in the troubleshooting and solution (possible 2 extra days) since it appears that the new CFAST was faulty, after flashing the original one it's working.
Troubleshooting also took much longer that it should due to the new update of the routers, the routers stop working (in rare cases), where we needed to factory reset the routers several times until it was working and due to this we needed to wait for the charger to go into Failsafemode to understand where the problem was.

additional_info.subject: ID0399022-DC/Si-D/FI-[nqq1M7] -Unable to download FW version 5.0.23 CRM:00315002246
additional_info.body:
Hi guys, good morning.
Just a quick update on the ticket.
When we arrived on site the charger was in boot loop and didn't even reach the Hello screen or the usual Siemens screen with the % of loading.
When we flashed the CFAST, we got a new ID (possible that something went wrong in the restore config) and we got to failsafemode since the Routers had the previous password.
It seems that Router 2 completely went faulty since we cannot reach it or access it, so we replaced it but Router 1 also looks faulty as at first I could access it via SSH and not via WebUI but now I can't access neither.
After you replaced the Router 2 the charger didn't come back online and it seems Router 1 is faulty too.
Let me know when you are able to go on site and replace the router.
Thank you and apologies for this trouble so far.
Best regards,
Francisco

additional_info.subject: ID0399022-DC/Si-D/FI-[nqq1M7] -Unable to download FW version 5.0.23 CRM:00315002246
additional_info.body:
Hi Sakari,
Unfortunately, I can only theorize that after the update, we ran into a conflict or similar in the CFAST that caused it to do that first boot loop with just Sicharge OC 5.0.23, after that we replaced the CFAST to no avail, it seems that this CFAST is not working properly either way, we need to check why the Amazon cloudwatch service is not working and the IDs are being created everytime we start up.
Quick summary of all the interventions that we did:
Tried a new CFAST and didn't work with the problem mentioned above
Factory reseted the routers when connection was not possible/failsafe mode was active
Retried the original CFAST (newly flashed) and it worked after some router factory resets and flashing of routers.
The charger is now in v6.0.3 and working.
Let me know if this information is enough for you and I will close the ticket.
Best regards,
Francisco

For the claim process I would like to add that the troubleshooting for us in the region, L2 and L3 and even help with R&D took 5 days and multiple site interventions, so it was not at all typical issue.
